description: This Java class defines a background service 'FileTransferService' that handles file transfer requests over Wi-Fi Direct by establishing socket connections, reading files through Android's ContentResolver, and writing data to the network socket.

classes.name: FileTransferService
classes.description: An Android IntentService that processes file transfer requests by establishing socket connections to send files over Wi-Fi Direct.

methods.name: FileTransferService
methods.description: Constructor used for creating the service with a specific name.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Handles incoming intents to send a file over a socket connection by retrieving URI and connection info from extras, opening the input file stream, and writing to a network socket.
